hypothesis: For N=2p and N=4p sampled in three bands up to 1e6, rho remains below 0.75 and last-minus-first band sup is at most 0.15.
refutation: Any sampled rho >= 0.75 OR either family has sup(last band)-sup(first band) > 0.15.
design: seed 20261124; 100 primes per nonempty family/band; bands (1e5,3e5], (3e5,6e5], (6e5,1e6].
